cards.front: Recall a key point about Tenses: Future and Conditional
cards.back: This topic covers key vocabulary and structures for tenses: future and conditional. You need to know the topic vocabulary, be able to use it in all four skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing), and express opinions with reasons.

cards.front: What should you know about gcse spanish exam tips?
cards.back: Use the future tense for plans and predictions. Use the conditional for hypothetical situations, polite requests and advice. Use ir a + infinitive for near future. Know the irregular future/conditional stems.

cards.front: What does el futuro simple mean?
cards.back: the simple future (e.g. Hablaré español con fluidez)
the conditional (e.g. Viajaría por todo el mundo)
the hypothesis (e.g. El condicional expresa hipótesis)
the prediction (e.g. Haré una predicción sobre el futuro)
the politeness (e.g. Usa el condicional para cortesía)
the infinitive (e.g. Las terminaciones se añaden al infinitivo)
the probability (e.g. El futuro expresa probabilidad)
the plan (e.g. Mis planes para el futuro incluyen estudiar)

cards.front: What does la situación hipotética mean?
cards.back: the hypothetical situation (e.g. Si tuviera dinero, compraría una casa)

cards.front: What does ir a + infinitivo mean?
cards.back: going to + infinitive (e.g. Voy a estudiar esta noche)
the wish/desire (e.g. Me gustaría viajar a Japón)
the condition (e.g. Si + imperfecto de subjuntivo, condicional)
Writing task: Write about future tense, conditional tense, near future, irregular stems, uses of each tense.
